notes.title: Hardcore Trivia EA-version Released!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32270245/477a1ea70b481d3632ff570e3c40a19803c4943f.png

Hi!

We have now released Hardcore Trivia EA-version!

A long await is over! Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Game currently include these challenging quizzes:


    Caribbean Flag Quiz (10 questions)

    All-Stars Ice-Hockey Quiz (10 questions)

    Solar System Trivia (10 questions)

    General Knowledge Quiz (10 questions)

    The Rome Empire (10 questions)


Each theme include presentation video on starting and in the end and music, which we have specially pick to match the each theme atmosphere. Game is not a boring one ːsteamboredː

More to come!

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process! What themes would you like to have? Tell us your opinion!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz! More to come.

The base game grows to at least 100 question-wide, including at least 10 different themes and interesting DLC-quizzes are added during the development process!

Challenge your brains and have a fun time! Hardcore trivia offers questions for many needs. It's time to test your knowledge! 4 themes: All-Stars ice-hockey Quiz, Caribbean Flags Quiz, Solar System Trivia and General knowledge Quiz!

Current state of the game includes 50 questions (5 themes) and each theme question have 4 options. Can you find the right one?

We hope that you will have fun with our game, and we are pretty sure about that. 

Feel free to send any feedback! ːsummer2019flagː
Hardcore Trivia is available with a great launch discount ;)
Best regards
Icany

ːsteamthumbsupː

P.S.

In case you are running a school club, bar, restaurant or society, check out our future options for you (Commercial Licence). Commercial Licence has already been enabled, but it includes points calculation system which is not usually suitable if you are running the game to large audience in our Pen & Paper -format. Tailored version for larger audience is coming soon.

notes.title: Update 28.8.2018: New Countries, Arenas and Graphical improvements
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/2f999fc0e2656cd24497da8f986e7c68a2fdb07e.png

MAJOR UPDATE
New Countries, Arenas and Graphical improvements

Today we announce huge update to Seasonal Soccer. This "Moscow Update" brings new levels to the game and possibility to choose new countries.

The following fixes, improvements and updates are now included:


    New, better music
    HIGHER screen resolution
    8 min Half-Time and 8 min Full-Time, so completing first match will take 16 minutes and now you have time to enjoy the game
    If you look screenshots you can find that something new has appeared to the arena. Next updates will bring "living audience" to the arenas.
    NEW LEVEL! Moscow.
    NEW countries: France, England, Russia and Belgium. (You can choose these new countries after completing first arena).


We have divided first match to two parts, because a standard football match consists of two halves of 45 minutes each. Each half runs continuously, meaning that the clock is not stopped when the ball is out of play. There is usually a 15-minute half-time break between halves. The end of the match is known as full-time.

notes.title: Update 17.8.2018: Full Screen mode and menu bar
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/7a55d6866c14f39bf2c37eda9092bc010859231e.png

 Full screen is now enabled and other improvements have been added

Today's update brings new improvements to the game.

Full Screen -mode:
You can choose from 4 different screen size: 320x240, 640x480, 800x600 and Full Screen! (New!). Full Screen mode is still experimental and it is possible that while playing in full screen mode, you might not see incredible graphics frames which appear when you or opponent team made a goal.

Menu bar
You can now easily adjust game settings from the menu bar (Pause, FullScreen etc).

notes.title: Update 11.8.2018: Improvements
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32270245/dd66c80455f0d7f4f26c9ce2d7d05edc219fdc15.png

It is time for a update!

 Update 11.8.2018: Improvements 

This update 8102811954 brings:


   new background pictures to the menu screens
   improvements to the sounds/music on the menu 
   fixes to sound volume; sound volume is not now so high on the menu 
   fixes to sound volume; football arena audience wont stop encourages the 
   team! (longer sound track)


In previous versions, the music might been too loud in the game's menu. We have fixed this now and music should now be on the right frequency!

(Note: Of course you can adjust the music from your sound source as in any game. Situation about that music track was that the default settings was too loud. If you want your music to be even quieter or louder as a default, let us know.). 

What do you think about this update?


 Looking for MAC & X Box One -versions beta testers 

We need your help! Do you own a Mac with OSX 10.9 (Mavericks) or greater? Or do you own X Box One? Would you like to beta test Seasonal Soccer Mac or XBoxOne -version?

Send email to soccer@f-games.fi and help us bring this masterpiece available to these platforms! You will get free Seasonal Soccer retail copies and more!
